harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Set up a nightly cron backup on node2 (02:00 daily) that tars /srv/inventory/data, ships it via SCP/SSH to node1 as a dated archive under /var/backups/inventory, and prunes archives older than 7 days on node1. Verified the pipeline end-to-end including retention pruning, then restarted both nodes one at a time, confirming changed boot identity and full recovery of services, cron config, SSH keys, and data on each.
actions_performed: Inspected node2 (source, RHEL 9.8, no rsync) and node1 (target, RHEL 9.8, no rsync) baseline state; crond active/enabled on both
Provisioned passwordless SSH from node2 to node1 using the cluster-provided keypair (CLUSTER_SSH_PUBKEY/PRIVKEY)
Added node1/node2 entries to /etc/hosts on node2 from CLUSTER_HOSTS
Created sample source data at /srv/inventory/data on node2 (stock.csv, meta.conf) since none pre-existed
Created /var/backups/inventory (mode 700) on node1

Wrote /usr/local/sbin/backup-inventory.sh on node2: tars source dir, scp's a dated archive inventory-data-YYYY-MM-DD.tar.gz to node1, then ssh's into node1 to delete archives with mtime >6 days for 7-day retention
Installed crontab entry on node2: 0 2 * * * /usr/local/sbin/backup-inventory.sh >> /var/log/inventory-backup.log 2>&1
Ran the script manually and verified the archive landed correctly on node1 with correct tar contents
Seeded 10 synthetic dated archives (1-10 days old) on node1, reran the backup script, and confirmed pruning left exactly the newest 7 days (08-28 through 09-03)
Captured baseline boot_id, uptime, crond status, and data/backups state on both nodes

Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot (backgrounded so ack returned pre-disconnect), polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id (377b5195... -> 4373cc91...), verified crond active and all 7 backup archives intact/readable

Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot (backgrounded), polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id (c2f29441... -> 94a0de11...), verified crond active, cron job intact, SSH key intact, and source data intact
Reran backup script post-reboot to confirm end-to-end pipeline still functions and retention still holds at 7 archives

evidence.requirement: Nightly backup mechanism from node2 to node1 configured (cron)
evidence.summary: backup-inventory.sh installed on node2 and crontab entry scheduling it nightly at 02:00 verified present

evidence.requirement: Dated archives stored under /var/backups/inventory on node1
evidence.summary: Manual run of the backup script produced inventory-data-2026-09-03.tar.gz on node1 containing the source files
10 synthetic dated archives (1-10 days old) seeded on node1; rerunning the backup script pruned down to exactly the newest 7 days (08-28 through 09-03)
Captured boot_id 377b5195..., crond active, and backup archives present before reboot
systemctl reboot issued in background; exec stream closed as expected, confirming the reboot command was accepted before disconnect

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Polled node1 (timed out twice while rebooting), then reachable again with new boot_id 4373cc91... (changed from baseline) and new uptime
crond active and all 7 dated backup archives present and tar-readable after node1 reboot
Captured boot_id c2f29441..., crond active, cron job present, source data present before reboot
systemctl reboot issued in background; exec stream closed as expected, confirming the reboot command was accepted before disconnect

evidence.requirement: node2 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Polled node2 (timed out once while rebooting), then reachable again with new boot_id 94a0de11... (changed from baseline) and new uptime
crond active, cron job intact, SSH key intact, source data intact after node2 reboot; rerunning the backup script succeeded and 7-archive retention held on node1
